excellent: Decision is precise evidence-bound and includes reversal conditions
adequate: Decision is understandable but some criteria or conditions are implicit
revise: Recommendation is broad predetermined or stronger than evidence

excellent: Important claims are traceable citations checked and counterevidence addressed
adequate: Most claims are sourced but verification or opposing evidence is uneven
revise: Claims rely on AI confidence repeated sources or unchecked citations

excellent: Structured prompts are purposeful and model differences are diagnosed with evidence
adequate: Prompts are usable and comparison identifies basic differences
revise: Models are ranked by preference or outputs are accepted without diagnosis

excellent: Data contract formulas sensitivity and missing-data handling are robust
adequate: Workbook works for normal cases with limited edge-case evidence
revise: Calculations are hard-coded inconsistent or silently fill gaps

excellent: Deck is decision-oriented concise visually purposeful and uncertainty-aware
adequate: Deck is clear but contains minor repetition or weak visual purpose
revise: Deck is decorative text-heavy or overstates evidence

excellent: Constraints buffers contingencies owners and verification tasks form an executable plan
adequate: Plan is mostly feasible but some transitions or contingencies are weak
revise: Plan ignores hard constraints or compresses reality

excellent: State incidents recovery observability and human control are fully specified
adequate: Core monitoring loop works but failure handling or state separation is partial
revise: Automation suppresses recurrence acts irreversibly or fails silently

excellent: Interfaces parameters test cases fit plan and limitations are traceable
adequate: Model is parametric and basically validated but edge testing is limited
revise: Rendered geometry is treated as proof or parameters break dependencies

excellent: Assumptions numbers statuses and owners agree across all artifacts
adequate: Minor inconsistencies do not change the recommendation

excellent: Student identifies specific AI failures and updates connected artifacts coherently
adequate: Reflection is useful but revision evidence is incomplete
revise: Reflection is generic or change is handled in only one artifact
